parameters.query:
-- Reconstruct pending order from the last bulk-order bot reply
-- Look for the last outbound message containing pricing data for this customer
SELECT message_text, created_at
FROM conversations
WHERE
  business_id     = '{{ $json.business_id }}'
  AND customer_number = '{{ $json.phoneNumber }}'
  AND direction   = 'outbound'
ORDER BY created_at DESC
LIMIT 1;

nodes.name: Fetch Last Bulk Quote
nodes.notes: Fetches the last bot reply to reconstruct order context. In production, store pending orders in a dedicated table.

nodes.name: Build Order Object
nodes.notes: Builds the order record from context. Link to a pending_orders session store in Phase 2 for full accuracy.

parameters.query:
-- §10.4 Node 2: Upsert customer record
INSERT INTO customers (business_id, phone_number, total_orders, last_order_date)
VALUES ('{{ $json.business_id }}', '{{ $json.phoneNumber }}', 1, now())
ON CONFLICT (business_id, phone_number)
DO UPDATE SET
  total_orders    = customers.total_orders + 1,
  last_order_date = now()
RETURNING id AS customer_id, total_orders;

-- §10.4 Node 2: Insert order record
INSERT INTO orders
  (business_id, customer_id, customer_number, items, total_price, discount_applied, status)
VALUES ('{{ $('Build Order Object').item.json.business_id }}', '{{ $json.customer_id }}', '{{ $('Build Order Object').item.json.phoneNumber }}', '{{ JSON.stringify($('Build Order Object').item.json.items).replace(/'/g, "''") }}'::jsonb, '{{ $('Build Order Object').item.json.total_price }}', '{{ $('Build Order Object').item.json.discount_applied }}', 'confirmed')
RETURNING id AS order_id;

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO conversations (business_id, customer_number, direction, message_text)
VALUES ('{{ $('Build Order Object').item.json.business_id }}', '{{ $('Build Order Object').item.json.phoneNumber }}', 'outbound', 'Order confirmed — confirmation message sent.');

WITH items AS (
  SELECT (value->>'product_name') AS p_name, (value->>'qty')::int AS p_qty
  FROM jsonb_array_elements('{{ JSON.stringify($('Build Order Object').item.json.items).replace(/'/g, "''") }}'::jsonb)
)
UPDATE products p
SET stock = GREATEST(p.stock - items.p_qty, 0)
FROM items
WHERE p.business_id = '{{ $('Build Order Object').item.json.business_id }}'
  AND p.name ILIKE items.p_name;
